parallel.requirements: The parent recognized pure Node ESM, local-only imports, /output delivery, exact CLI parsing, Python-style list output, black-box executable probing, and the two-stage convertbits flow.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership while spawning a CLI probe child. The first child also spawned a nested probe and later began its own /workspace/output setup, but the parent did not depend on that implementation path.
parallel.implementation: The parent added pythonErrors, pythonIntegers, convertbits, pythonRepr, argparseLike, and test14.mjs under /output using Number-based bit math and a basename-derived program name.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The delivered artifact came from the parent-owned /output files. The first child began a separate /workspace/output subtree but was interrupted, and that subtree was not the artifact listed at closure.
parallel.verification: The parent probed executable behavior, ran Node sample cases, checked parser errors, and diffed the four provided samples against the executable before finalizing.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation failed 2 of 32 samples. The final response itself notes a program-name difference for CLI messages, and runtime failure checks showed Node stack traces rather than Python/PyInstaller tracebacks.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same pure Node ESM, local-only import, manual CLI parsing, output formatting, /output placement, and executable parity requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery, with no delegated work or subagent handoff.
serial.implementation: The serial run created runtime error, integer parsing, convert-bits, Python repr, parse-args, and test14.mjs modules, then patched error class names and hard-coded the executable-style program name.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All files were created directly under /output and the final listed the expected entry file and library modules, with no competing workspace tree or child artifact.
serial.verification: The serial agent probed more CLI precedence and runtime exception cases, verified sample outputs and parser errors after final patches, and listed the final artifact files.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation also failed 2 of 32 samples. The serial final explicitly identified the remaining mismatch as Node traceback formatting for post-parse runtime failures.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the key requirements, including local ESM modules, manual CLI parsing, convertbits behavior, and black-box probing of the executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and additionally emphasized fixing the help/error banner to the executable name.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement coverage was mostly the same; serial pursued the executable-name detail more fully, while both left runtime traceback formatting incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent owned final implementation but spawned a probe child, and that child spawned another probe before starting separate output setup.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent kept a single-owner plan for probing, implementation, verification, and delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel added duplicated delegated investigation and an abandoned child-side implementation attempt, while serial kept ownership centralized.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child trajectories received the same full user prompt in their raw session context, and the parent independently acquired the CLI facts it needed rather than relying on a missing or conflicting handoff.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained all task context locally and used its own executable probes to refine parser precedence, negative-number handling, and program-name output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No harmful context boundary is established: parallel child findings mostly duplicated parent probes, while serial consolidated the same facts in one thread.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a Number-based convertbits implementation and argparse-like parser, with basename-derived program names in the final delivered code.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a BigInt-based convertbits implementation, a parser module, and then patched test14.mjs to hard-code the executable-style program name.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial made more post-implementation refinements to match CLI text; both implementations still used Node exception output for runtime failures and both failed 2 official samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent waited twice for a still-running child and then interrupted it after its own implementation and verification path was already complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; all results were local command outputs and patches inspected by the same agent.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result lifecycle issue in the ordinary sense, but the interrupted child result was redundant and not tied to a distinct failed requirement, so it does not clear a retained taxonomy gate.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent delivered /output files, while the first child created /workspace/output directories after receiving nested probe findings; no evidence shows a collision with the submitted /output artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote only the final /output artifact tree from the single session and listed those files before finalization.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a stray child-side workspace tree but no proven overwrite, contamination, or shared-state conflict; serial had no shared-state risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel compared the four prompt sample cases and some CLI edge cases, then finalized before official evaluation showed 30/32.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also verified the samples and additional CLI behaviors, and it explicitly acknowledged unresolved runtime traceback formatting before the same 30/32 official result.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verification was broader on CLI text and more candid about residual traceback mismatch; neither run ran or inferred the hidden official cases that later failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 55 LLM requests, over one million total tokens, two spawned children, repeated waits, and one interrupt before closing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 24 LLM requests, no child agents, and fewer total tokens while spending slightly more wall-clock seconds on local probing and refinements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel coordination increased token/tool overhead and left one child unfinished, but it did not displace a required parent implementation step or create a unique official outcome gap.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcomes are not discordant: both completed and failed at 30/32. Both implemented the required ESM module tree and matched the provided sample cases. The main concrete difference is process and polish, not pass/fail: parallel duplicated CLI probing across parent and children, interrupted the still-running child after parent-owned delivery, and left program-name output as test14.mjs; serial stayed single-threaded, fixed the program-name output to test14_executable, and explicitly called out the remaining Node traceback mismatch. Because both scored identically, the evidence supports ordinary implementation differences and a non-causal parallel lifecycle inefficiency, not a retained concurrency error explaining an outcome delta.
parallel_contributors: Parent-owned implementation and sample verification produced the delivered artifact despite child work being abandoned.
Parallel final acknowledged the program-name difference between test14.mjs and test14_executable.
serial_contributors: Single-agent flow retained all probe findings in one context and patched the program-name output to test14_executable.
Serial final explicitly stated the residual traceback-format mismatch that remained after parser and sample verification.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used Number arithmetic while serial used BigInt arithmetic for convertbits.
Parallel basename-derived CLI output kept test14.mjs in usage/errors; serial hard-coded test14_executable.
Both produced Node stack traces for post-parse runtime exceptions rather than fully matching Python/PyInstaller tracebacks.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both modes failed with the same official score
